newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Cambodia says wants ASEAN to be mediator.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia says wants ASEAN to be mediator.

text.p: Cambodia wants the Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN) to mediate in the conflict between its two warring prime ministers, Cambodian Foreign Minister Ung Huot said on Wednesday.
"We have decided that we want to join ASEAN. We have also decided that we want ASEAN to be a mediator," he said.

Speaking to reporters after arriving in Kuala Lumpur for the annual ASEAN foreign ministers' meeting, Ung Huot said Phnom Penh's new stand on the issue reflected the wishes of Cambodian strongman Hun Sen.

"That is the new position," he said, when asked if Hun Sen endorsed ASEAN's mediation efforts. Last week, Hun Sen dismissed a mediation offer by an ASEAN delegation led by Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas, saying foreigners should stay out of Cambodia's business.
"We want to join right now. That is the other firm desire of Hun Sen, the second PM (prime minister)," Ung Huot said.

ASEAN postponed the admission of Cambodia, which was due to join on Wednesday along with Burma and Laos, after Hun Sen overthrew First Prime Minister Norodom Ranariddh earlier this month in a bloody putsch.
